speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing episodes of dizziness and vertigo; to help me determine the cause, can you describe exactly what the sensation feels like and how long each episode lasts?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old woman. The patient presents with sudden episodes of dizziness that are position dependent. She describes experiencing a false sensation of motion and occasional spinning, indicative of vertigo. She denies any recent illnesses, injuries, or significant changes in health status, apart from age-related hearing loss (presbycusis).

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details. Since the dizziness is position-dependent and accompanied by hearing loss, I need to assess your neurological function and inner ear status. Can you tell me if you have noticed any recent headaches, double vision, slurred speech, or weakness on one side of your body? Also, do you experience hearing loss in one ear or both?

REQUEST TEST: Dix-Hallpike maneuver.
